body:
I felt my heart pounding as I approached the old oak tree. Its gnarled roots spread out like ancient hands, whispering secrets from the past centuries. Sweat trickled down my forehead as fear began to simmer within me. 

The wind whispered through its leaves, each rustle carrying stories lost in time. My palms grew clammy as visions flickered across my mind—tragedies untold, dreams left unfulfilled.

I tried to steady my breath, focusing on my breathing. Each inhale was deep and slow, trying to calm my racing thoughts.

"Old friend," I murmured softly to the tree, "don't let anyone disturb you."
full:
I felt my heart pounding as I approached the old oak tree. Its gnarled roots spread out like ancient hands, whispering secrets from the past centuries. Sweat trickled down my forehead as fear began to simmer within me. 

The wind whispered through its leaves, each rustle carrying stories lost in time. My palms grew clammy as visions flickered across my mind—tragedies untold, dreams left unfulfilled.

I tried to steady my breath, focusing on my breathing. Each inhale was deep and slow, trying to calm my racing thoughts.

"Old friend," I murmured softly to the tree, "don't let anyone disturb you."

Next: put real distance between myself and it.
